parameters.query:
SELECT
  a.application_id,
  a.job_id,
  a.tenant_id,
  a.candidate_name,
  a.decision,
  COALESCE(a.final_score, 0) AS overall_score,
  a.received_at
FROM cv_analyzer.job_applications a
WHERE a.application_id = $1
  AND a.tenant_id = $2;

SELECT
  score_skills,
  score_experience,
  score_education,
  score_certifications,
  score_soft_skills,
  score_domain_knowledge,
  score_other_requirements,
  cv_skills_matched,
  cv_experience_summary,
  cv_education_summary,
  cv_certifications_found,
  cv_domain_experience,
  cv_other_notes,
  gaps_identified,
  interview_focus_points,
  interview_suggested_questions,
  evaluation_notes,
  raw_ai_response
FROM cv_analyzer.job_application_scores
WHERE application_id = $1
  AND tenant_id = $2
ORDER BY scored_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  job_id,
  skills_required,
  skills_preferred,
  experience_min_years,
  experience_roles,
  experience_responsibilities,
  education_level,
  education_fields,
  certifications,
  soft_skills,
  domain_knowledge,
  other_requirements,
  weight_skills,
  weight_experience,
  weight_education,
  weight_certifications,
  weight_soft_skills,
  weight_domain_knowledge,
  weight_other_requirements
FROM cv_analyzer.job_evaluation_profiles
WHERE job_id = $1
  AND tenant_id = $2;
